verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation such as saved-search alerts, webhooks or notification rules is a fair question for a federal data portal and API platform like SAM.gov, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows on-demand query APIs. The one email option (emailId=Yes) just delivers an extract download URL for a request the user made; it is not a rule fired by an event. Nothing in the pack shows user-defined rules or event triggers.
